instruction: In the 2019 personal costs table, calculate the average of the monthly total costs (column I, rows 3-14) and put the result in cell J3.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent attempted to create two column charts for 2019 and 2020 monthly costs. It understood the data structure and SUM formulas but struggled with multi-range selection in the chart wizard. Created one incomplete chart for 2019 but never created the second chart. Ran out of 50 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate LibreOffice Calc cells, understand data layout, use formulas (SUM), open Insert menu, interact with chart wizard dialog
metadata.failure_analysis: Failed to correctly select non-contiguous data ranges (months + totals) for chart creation. Spent excessive turns trying different selection methods. Only created one chart with incorrect data, never started second chart.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to a single formula task (AVERAGE) within the model's demonstrated capability of navigating cells and entering formulas
metadata.explanation: Task asks model to calculate average of monthly totals using AVERAGE formula. Evaluator checks cell J3 for value ~392.33 (=AVERAGE(I3:I14)) with tolerance of 1.0 to handle rounding.
